he_ctx.caption: שתי צפרים, עץ ארז, שני תולעת ואזוב

en: A small bird flying happily away into a wide open blue sky over a green field, free, a priest in a white robe watching it from below with open hands.
A Hebrew man with a short-shaved face washing his clothes in a clay basin of clean water beside a stream, happy, clean white robes drying on a bush.
A happy Hebrew man leading two white lambs toward a holy tent made of colorful curtains, a priest in a white robe and white turban waiting to greet him, morning light.
Two Hebrew workers with beards carefully pulling out a few stones that have greenish-red spots from the wall of a stone house, a priest in a white robe and white turban pointing at the spots.
The high priest, a man with a grey beard, wearing only simple pure white linen garments and a white turban, standing reverently at the entrance of a holy tent, glowing soft light.

he_ctx.caption: ביום כפור הכהן הגדול לובש בגדי לבן

en: The high priest, a man with a grey beard in white linen garments, standing between two identical brown goats and drawing two small golden tablets out of a wooden box, other priests in white watching.

The high priest, a man with a grey beard in white linen garments, walking slowly through a parted curtain into a dim inner room, holding a golden pan of glowing coals and a ladle of incense, fragrant smoke curling up.
A Hebrew man with a beard leading a brown goat by a rope far into an empty rocky desert toward distant cliffs, the camp far behind.
Hebrew men and boys dressed all in white standing together and praying with deep feeling, some with eyes closed, in a desert camp at sunset, a soft glow over them. Only men and boys in the picture.

A happy Hebrew father with a beard and his young sons joyfully doing mitzvot together: putting up a mezuzah case on a doorpost, learning from a scroll, and giving bread to a poor man, bright sunny day.

he_ctx.caption: וחי בהם: חיים עם המצוות בשמחה

en: A boy about eight years old respectfully bringing a cup of water and a plate of bread to his tired father, a man with a beard sitting on a chair at home, the father smiling warmly. Only the boy and his father in the picture.

A Hebrew farmer with a beard harvesting a golden wheat field with a sickle but leaving the corner of the field uncut, while a poor old man with a long grey beard and a basket happily gathers from that corner. Only these two bearded men in the picture.
A Hebrew farmer with a beard handing silver coins to a tired worker holding a hoe at sunset, both smiling, the field behind them.
A kind Hebrew boy removing a big stone from a path in front of an old blind man with a walking stick who is walking slowly, the boy holding the man's arm gently.
Two Hebrew boys about eight years old sharing their bread and fruit with each other and hugging as friends, sitting under a tree, happy faces.
A young Hebrew man with a short beard standing up from his seat with respect as an old man with a long white beard and a walking stick enters the room, others standing too.

A peaceful Shabbat table at evening in a stone house: two lit candles, two braided challah breads under a cover, a silver cup of wine, a father with a beard and his sons in festive white clothes singing together.
A Hebrew father with a beard and his sons sitting at a festive table eating round flat matzah, a plate of bitter herbs, cups of wine, at night, lamp light.
A Hebrew farmer with a beard proudly cutting the first bundle of golden barley in a field and carrying it in his arms to a priest in a white robe and white turban, spring morning.
A priest in a white robe and white turban lifting up two big golden loaves of bread, wheat fields and green hills in the background, early summer.
A Hebrew man with a beard wrapped in a white prayer shawl blowing a long curved ram's horn shofar, men and boys listening around him, autumn morning.

A Hebrew father with a beard and his young sons sitting happily inside a sukkah hut with a roof of green branches, the father holding a palm branch, a citron, myrtle and willow branches, colorful decorations.

he_ctx.caption: סכות: יושבים בסכה ולוקחים ארבעה מינים

en: A quiet field resting with no plowing and no planting, a wooden plow lying unused at the edge, a Hebrew farmer with a beard sitting under a tree and learning from a scroll, wildflowers growing.
An open orchard with no fence, the gate wide open, many different Hebrew men and boys and also some deer and birds happily picking and eating ripe figs, grapes and pomegranates.
A Hebrew man with a beard standing on a hilltop blowing a long ram's horn shofar, villages and fields below, people looking up joyfully.
Happy Hebrew men walking out through an open wooden gate toward their own homes and fields, waving, a farmer welcoming one of them back to his field.
A Hebrew merchant with a beard at a market stall weighing grain honestly on a balance scale for a customer, both smiling, baskets of fruit and grain around.
A kind Hebrew man with a beard holding the hand of a poor man and helping him stand up, giving him a bag of grain and a small sack of coins, a simple village street.
Hebrew men and boys sitting together under a big tree learning from scrolls with joy and excitement, a teacher with a white beard pointing in a scroll, sunny day.
Gentle rain falling from grey clouds onto green fields and young wheat sprouts, a Hebrew farmer with a beard smiling and looking up with open arms, a rainbow beginning to appear.

An orchard full of trees heavy with ripe fruit: pomegranates, figs, grapes, olives and dates, Hebrew boys with short hair and small skullcaps (no head scarves) climbing ladders and filling baskets happily, their bearded father helping. Only men and boys in the picture.
A Hebrew father with a beard and his sons around a table with plenty of fresh bread loaves, everyone eating happily and satisfied, a full granary visible through the window.
A peaceful village at night under the stars and moon, Hebrew men and boys sleeping calmly on rooftops, sheep resting quietly in a pen, a wolf far away walking off. Calm and safe.
A beautiful holy tent glowing with soft light in the very center of a big camp of tents, happy Hebrew families of men and boys around it, a gentle white cloud above it.

View from above of a huge orderly desert camp: one beautiful holy tent with a courtyard fence of white curtains exactly in the center, and around it on all four sides neat groups of small tents, each group with its own tall banner of a different plain color with no symbols, tiny people between the tents.

he_ctx.caption: המשכן באמצע וכל שבט עם דגלו

en: Inside a holy tent, three priests in white robes and white turbans spreading large blue and red cloths over golden holy objects: a golden seven-branched lamp stand half covered with a blue cloth, a golden table being wrapped in a red cloth. Soft light.

Strong Hebrew men with beards taking apart a holy tent in the desert: some rolling up big embroidered curtains, others carefully lowering tall golden wooden boards and pulling silver sockets out of the sand, poles and ropes lying around. Only men and boys in the picture.

Hebrew men with beards walking in the desert carrying holy objects on their shoulders with long golden poles: in front four men carrying a chest completely covered with a blue cloth, behind them men carrying other objects wrapped in blue and red cloths. Only men and boys in the picture.

he_ctx.caption: בני קהת נושאים את הכלים על הכתף

en: A very long orderly procession of Hebrew men and boys marching across the desert in separate groups one after another, each group led by a man holding a tall banner of a different plain color with no symbols, donkeys and sheep with them, a white pillar of cloud leading in the sky ahead. Only men and boys in the picture.

At a new place beside palm trees in the desert, Hebrew men with beards raising tall golden boards upright and stretching embroidered curtains over them to set up a holy tent again, while around them other men and boys pitch small tents and unload donkeys. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing in front of a newly finished beautiful holy tent with a white curtain fence, pouring golden oil from a small horn onto a copper altar, a white cloud resting above the tent, bright morning.

Twelve dignified tribal leaders with beards and fine colorful robes arriving in front of a holy tent, leading six covered wooden wagons each pulled by two oxen, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe watching them come.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe handing the rope of two oxen harnessed to an empty covered wooden wagon to a group of strong bearded men in simple robes who receive it gladly, more empty wagons with oxen waiting in a row behind.

Strong bearded Hebrew men lifting tall heavy golden wooden boards and rolled curtains and loading them onto wooden wagons harnessed to oxen in the desert, working together. Only men and boys in the picture.

One dignified tribal leader with a black beard and a royal purple robe walking alone toward a copper altar in front of a holy tent, carrying a large silver bowl in his hands, behind him helpers leading one bull, one ram and one lamb, a priest in white waiting at the altar.

Twelve dignified tribal leaders with beards standing in a half circle around a copper altar with a small fire, on the ground before the altar twelve shining silver bowls and twelve small golden spoons arranged in neat rows, a holy tent behind, festive joyful mood.

he_ctx.caption: שנים עשר נשיאים הביאו: המזבח חנוך

en: A small group of four sad Hebrew men with beards standing apart at the edge of a desert camp with heads lowered, while in the camp behind them happy families of men and boys sit around small fires roasting lambs and celebrating. Only men and boys in the picture.

he_ctx.caption: אנשים לא יכלו להקריב פסח ועצובים

en: Four Hebrew men with beards standing before Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe and Aaron, an old man with a grey beard wearing a white priestly robe and a white turban, pleading with open hands and asking a question, Moses listening kindly with attention, desert camp tents behind.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing alone at the entrance of a holy tent with his head bowed and hands open, a white cloud resting on top of the tent and soft light shining from inside, the four men waiting far away in the background.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe coming out with a wide smile and open arms toward four Hebrew men with beards who are now jumping with joy and raising their hands happily, a holy tent with a white cloud behind him.

Four happy Hebrew men with beards bringing a white lamb to a copper altar in the courtyard of a holy tent, a priest in a white robe and white turban receiving them, a thin crescent moon faintly visible in the afternoon sky.

Evening: four happy Hebrew men with beards and their sons sitting together on mats at the entrance of a tent, eating roasted meat with round flat unleavened breads and green bitter lettuce leaves from wooden plates, a full moon in the sky, a small fire. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing in the desert camp and pointing toward distant green mountains, twelve men with walking sticks and travel bags standing in a row before him ready to go, tents behind.

Twelve travelers with walking sticks, seen from behind, standing on a hilltop and looking down at a rich green land: big stone walled cities, vineyards, fruit trees and golden fields in a wide valley.

In a vineyard, two Hebrew men with beards cutting an enormous bunch of purple grapes, as big as a man, from a thick vine with a knife, a third man holding the giant bunch from below, another holding huge pomegranates and figs.

Men walking into a desert camp carrying one enormous bunch of purple grapes hanging from a long wooden pole on their shoulders, others carrying giant pomegranates and figs, showing them to Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe while a crowd of amazed men and boys gathers around. Only men and boys in the picture.

Night in the desert camp: a group of ten men with frightened faces waving their arms and speaking fearfully to a big crowd, the men and boys in the crowd crying, holding their heads and wiping tears, tents and torches around. Only men and boys in the picture.

Two brave men standing on a rock in front of a crowd in the desert camp, one with a short black beard and a red-brown robe, one with a brown beard and a green robe, speaking with confident smiles and pointing with raised arms toward distant green mountains, bright sunrise. Only men and boys in the picture.

he_ctx.caption: כלב ויהושע: טובה הארץ מאד מאד

en: Korach, an angry rich man with a long black beard and a fancy striped blue robe, standing at the head of a group of men and arguing loudly with a pointing finger at Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe, who answers calmly and humbly, desert camp tents behind.

Twelve dignified tribal leaders with beards standing in a line, each one holding out a plain dry wooden staff and handing it to Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe, who already holds several staffs in his arm.

Evening inside a holy tent with embroidered curtains: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe carefully laying twelve plain dry wooden staffs side by side in a neat row on the floor, an oil lamp stand glowing softly beside him.

he_ctx.caption: משה מניח את המטות באהל מועד

en: Sunrise in the desert: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe seen from behind, pulling aside the curtain at the entrance of a holy tent to walk in, a crowd of curious tribal leaders and men waiting outside at a distance and watching eagerly.

Close view on the floor of a holy tent: twelve wooden staffs lying side by side in a row, eleven of them plain and dry, and one in the middle covered with fresh green leaves and beautiful white and pink blossoms. No people.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing outside a holy tent holding up high a wooden staff that has green leaves, blossoms and ripe almonds growing on it, Aaron, an old man with a grey beard wearing a white priestly robe and a white turban standing humbly beside him, the amazed tribal leaders each holding his own plain dry staff and looking at it.

Thirsty Hebrew men and boys in a hot dry desert camp under a burning sun, turning their empty clay jugs and leather water bags upside down with not a drop coming out, a dry empty stone well, tired thirsty sheep and donkeys. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe and Aaron, an old man with a grey beard wearing a white priestly robe and a white turban kneeling side by side with bowed heads at the entrance of a holy tent, praying, a white cloud resting above the tent and soft light shining on them.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe inside a holy tent with embroidered curtains, reaching out with both hands and lifting a special long wooden staff from its place beside a golden lamp stand.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe holding a wooden staff and Aaron, an old man with a grey beard wearing a white priestly robe and a white turban standing in front of one huge dry grey rock in the desert, a big crowd of thirsty men and boys with empty jugs gathered in a half circle facing the rock and waiting. Only men and boys in the picture.

A great stream of clear blue water bursting out of a huge grey desert rock and flowing over the sand like a river, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing beside the rock holding his wooden staff, the crowd of men and boys cheering with raised arms. Only men and boys in the picture.

Happy Hebrew men and boys kneeling beside a clear stream flowing through the desert, drinking from their cupped hands and filling clay jugs, sheep, cows and donkeys drinking from the water next to them, a big rock in the background. Only men and boys in the picture.

Balak, a king with a golden crown, a red beard and a red royal cloak, standing on top of a stone city wall with a worried frightened face, looking down at an enormous camp of thousands of tents filling the whole plain below.

Balak, a king with a golden crown, a red beard and a red royal cloak, sitting on a throne and sending out three messengers in fine robes who carry small chests full of gold coins and lead camels out of the palace gate.

Balaam, a foreign sorcerer with a pointed grey beard, a dark purple robe and a tall pointed hat, riding on a grey donkey along a country road, two servant youths walking behind him, hills and vineyards around, morning.

A grey donkey lying down flat on its belly on a narrow path between two low stone vineyard walls and refusing to move, Balaam, a foreign sorcerer with a pointed grey beard, a dark purple robe and a tall pointed hat, standing next to it angry and confused with a stick in his hand. Nothing else on the path.

On a high mountain top, seven small stone altars standing in one row, workers placing the last stones, Balaam, a foreign sorcerer with a pointed grey beard, a dark purple robe and a tall pointed hat, and a king with a golden crown and a red beard standing beside them, far below in the valley a huge camp of tents.

Balaam, a foreign sorcerer with a pointed grey beard, a dark purple robe and a tall pointed hat, standing on a mountain top with both arms spread wide and a surprised gentle smile, looking down at a beautiful orderly camp of tents in the valley glowing in golden light, beside him a king with a golden crown and a red beard clapping his hands in anger.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe and several old men with white beards standing at the entrance of a holy tent, very sad and crying, covering their faces with their hands, a grey cloudy sky.

he_ctx.caption: משה והזקנים בוכים בפתח אהל מועד

en: Pinchas, a brave young man with a short black beard in a simple white robe, rising up with determination from among a seated crowd of sad men and taking a long spear in his hand, standing tall and brave, the others looking up at him. No fighting, no blood. Only men and boys in the picture.

The desert camp after a hard time: the dark grey clouds parting and bright warm sunshine breaking through over the tents, weak tired men and boys getting up from their mats, helping each other stand and smiling with relief. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe placing a white priestly turban on the head of a young man with a short black beard who now wears a white priestly robe with a colorful sash, an old priest with a grey beard smiling beside them, a holy tent behind, peaceful sunny day.

he_ctx.caption: פינחס מקבל ברית שלום ונהיה כהן

en: A young priest with a short black beard in a white robe and white turban walking at the head of an army of Hebrew men with round shields and spears, blowing a long straight silver trumpet, banners of plain colors behind him, marching out of the desert camp. No fighting, no blood.

he_ctx.caption: פינחס יוצא למלחמה במדין עם החצוצרות

en: Two Hebrew shepherds with beards, one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, standing in the dry desert surrounded by enormous flocks of sheep, goats and cows that fill the whole picture, very little grass on the ground.

Two Hebrew shepherds with beards, one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, seen from behind on a hill, looking with delight at a wide empty land of rich green meadows and streams below, their sheep beside them.

Two Hebrew shepherds with beards, one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, holding shepherd crooks and standing respectfully before Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe and a priest in white, asking with open hands and pointing back at green meadows, sheep behind them.

Two Hebrew men with beards, one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, now holding round shields and spears, standing before Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe with their right hands on their hearts, making a promise, Moses nodding and agreeing.

Hebrew men with beards building low round stone fences for sheep in a green meadow, sheep already inside one finished pen, in the background other men building stone houses and a wall of a small town, boys carrying stones. Only men and boys in the picture.

Hebrew men with round shields and spears, led by one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, wading first across a shallow blue river, behind them on the river bank a great crowd of men and boys following, green land on the far side. No fighting.

A great joyful crowd of Hebrew men and boys with bundles on their shoulders, donkeys and sheep walking out on a road away from big pyramids and palm trees in the background, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe leading with a staff, sunrise. Only men and boys in the picture.

A great crowd of Hebrew men and boys walking on a dry sandy path through the middle of a sea, two towering walls of blue water with fish standing on both sides, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe holding up his staff. Only men and boys in the picture.

A beautiful green desert oasis with many tall date palm trees and twelve small round springs of clear blue water, Hebrew men and boys resting in the shade, drinking and filling jugs, tents among the palms. Only men and boys in the picture.

he_ctx.caption: אילם: שתים עשרה עינות ושבעים תמרים

en: A huge camp of tents spread on a desert plain facing one tall rocky mountain whose top is covered with thick cloud and bright light, the lower slopes of the mountain covered with green grass and flowers, men and boys standing and looking at the mountain. Only men and boys in the picture.

A long line of Hebrew men and boys with camels and donkeys walking over endless yellow sand dunes, a tall white pillar of cloud leading them in the sky, a covered chest carried on poles at the front, hot sun. Only men and boys in the picture.

A huge camp of tents on a green plain beside a blue river, across the river a stone walled city surrounded by palm trees, Hebrew men and boys standing on the river bank looking happily across at the green land beyond. Only men and boys in the picture.

A huge crowd of Hebrew men and boys with donkeys, sheep and bundles walking away from a tall rocky desert mountain behind them, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe leading at the front with a wooden staff, morning light. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing on a low rock and placing his hand on the shoulder of one of several wise older bearded men standing in a row before him, appointing them as helpers, desert camp tents behind, people watching. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe pointing toward distant green hills while twelve men with walking sticks and small travel bags set out on a path toward the hills, seen from behind, desert camp at the side.

A very long winding line of Hebrew men and boys with camels, donkeys and sheep walking across wide yellow sand dunes, the path curving in big loops around a brown mountain range, a tall white pillar of cloud ahead of them, hot sun. Only men and boys in the picture.

Hebrew men with round shields and spears cheering with raised arms in front of a big stone walled city whose gates stand open, a fallen enormous iron crown and a giant empty iron bed lying beside the gate, no fighting, no blood, joyful victory.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe pointing with an open hand over wide green pasture land beside a blue river, two happy bearded shepherds standing next to him with very large flocks of sheep and cows grazing all over the meadows.

Close view of a Hebrew man with a brown beard, wrapped in a white prayer shawl with dark stripes, covering his eyes with his right hand while praying with deep devotion at sunrise, golden morning light, a small boy beside him also covering his eyes with his hand.

Inside a simple stone house, a Hebrew father with a beard sitting at a wooden table with his two young sons, an open scroll with blank parchment on the table, the father pointing at the scroll and teaching, the boys listening eagerly, oil lamp on the table.

A Hebrew father with a beard and his young son walking side by side along a country dirt road between olive trees and hills, a donkey carrying sacks next to them, the father talking and gesturing as he teaches, the boy looking up at him, sunny day.

Night time in a cozy room: a small boy lying in his bed under a blanket covering his eyes with his hand, his father with a beard sitting on the edge of the bed next to him, a window with moon and stars, a small oil lamp glowing.

A Hebrew man with a beard wearing a white prayer shawl, a small black leather box on his forehead held by a black strap, carefully winding a black leather strap around his bare left forearm with a small black box on the upper arm, morning light, calm and focused.

A Hebrew father with a beard lifting his little son up to the doorpost of their stone house so the boy can touch with his fingertips a tiny slim wooden case, only as long as a hand and as thin as two fingers, fixed diagonally high on the right doorpost, open wooden door, flowers by the entrance, sunny.

A Hebrew farmer with a beard walking behind two brown oxen that pull a simple wooden plow, cutting straight furrows in bare brown soil, an empty brown field all around, hills in the distance, early morning.

A Hebrew farmer with a beard walking along the furrows of a plowed brown field, scattering golden grain seeds from a cloth bag hanging on his shoulder with a wide swing of his arm, a small boy with a little bag helping, birds in the sky.

Gentle rain falling from grey clouds on a field where rows of small fresh green sprouts are coming up from the brown soil, puddles between the rows, a farmer and his boy standing under a tree smiling and holding out their hands to feel the rain.

A wide field of tall golden ripe wheat under a bright sun, Hebrew farmers with beards cutting the wheat with sickles and tying it into big golden sheaves, boys carrying sheaves to a pile. Only men and boys in the picture.

A Hebrew father with a beard and his three sons sitting around a wooden table, each one holding and biting a piece of fresh round bread, a big basket full of bread loaves, olives and a jug of water on the table, everyone eating happily.

After the meal: a Hebrew father with a beard and his three sons sitting at a wooden table with empty plates and only crumbs left, all of them with eyes closed and faces lifted up, hands held together on their chests in thankful prayer, warm golden light coming through the window.

Spring time with blossoming almond trees: a Hebrew father with a beard and his sons walking up to the gate of a great golden stone temple, the father carrying a white lamb on his shoulders, other families of men and boys walking with lambs too. Only men and boys in the picture.

A Hebrew father with a beard and his sons sitting around a low table, eating round flat thin unleavened breads, a tall stack of the flat round breads on the table, spring flowers seen through the window, in the corner a small clay oven with flat breads baking.

A Hebrew farmer with a beard cutting the very first sheaf of green-golden barley with a sickle at the edge of a field that is still standing uncut, beside him his young son counting on his fingers, and a row of seven small stones laid on a flat rock.

Early summer: a joyful Hebrew father and his sons standing in a golden stone temple courtyard, the father holding two large loaves of bread on a tray, the boys holding baskets of wheat sheaves decorated with flowers, other men rejoicing around. Only men and boys in the picture.

Autumn: Hebrew farmers with beards on a round stone threshing floor shoveling big heaps of golden grain into sacks, boys treading purple grapes in a stone wine press beside it, donkeys loaded with full sacks, leaves turning yellow. Only men and boys in the picture.

A Hebrew father with a beard and his sons sitting happily inside a booth made of wooden poles with a roof of green palm branches, fruits hanging from the roof, the father holding a tall green palm branch and a yellow citron fruit, more booths in the background, golden city behind. Only men and boys in the picture.

Two Hebrew men with beards arguing in a village street, each one holding one end of the rope of the same brown goat standing between them and pulling it toward himself, upset faces, a few boys watching from the side.

Two Hebrew men with beards walking together with a brown goat toward a big stone city gate, where a wise old judge with a long white beard sits on a stone bench in the shade of the gate, an officer with a wooden staff standing beside him.

At the stone city gate, two serious men standing side by side in front of a seated old judge with a long white beard, one of them raising his hand as he speaks and tells what he saw, the judge listening very carefully with his hand on his beard.

A wise old judge with a long white beard sitting on a stone bench, turning his head away and holding up his open palm in a clear refusing gesture, while a man in rich clothes holds out a leather bag overflowing with gold coins toward him.

A wise old judge with a long white beard standing up at the city gate, with one hand holding a brass balance scale with two perfectly even pans, with the other hand pointing to one of two men, who is happily receiving the rope of the brown goat.

Two Hebrew men with beards shaking hands warmly and smiling at each other in front of the stone city gate, the brown goat standing calmly beside one of them, the old judge with a white beard smiling in the background.

A little white lamb running away alone over a green hill toward a forest, while far behind it a flock of sheep grazes and a shepherd with a beard sits under a tree facing the other way and does not notice.

A kind Hebrew man with a short black beard and a blue robe, walking on a path between trees with a bundle of wood on his back, stopping surprised as he finds a little white lamb standing alone and lost among the bushes.

A kind Hebrew man with a short black beard and a blue robe carrying a little white lamb in his arms through the open wooden gate of the yard of his small stone house, his young son running out of the door to greet them.

In the yard of a small stone house, a kind Hebrew man with a short black beard and a blue robe kneeling and feeding a little white lamb fresh green grass from his hand, his young son putting down a bowl of water, a small straw shelter beside them.

A worried shepherd with a grey beard and a brown robe, holding a shepherd's crook, walking along a village path and shading his eyes with his hand as he searches in every direction, looking behind bushes and stone fences.

A kind Hebrew man with a short black beard and a blue robe handing a little white lamb into the open arms of a very happy shepherd with a grey beard and a brown robe holding a crook, both smiling widely, a young boy clapping beside them, stone house behind.

Close view of a fig tree branch with big green leaves and one single first ripe purple fig, a Hebrew farmer with a beard looking at it with delight and pointing at it, his orchard behind him, morning sun.

Close view of the hands of a Hebrew farmer with a beard tying a thin red thread around the stem of a ripe purple fig still growing on the fig tree, big green leaves around, a small boy watching closely.

A Hebrew farmer with a beard and his son placing beautiful first fruits into a woven basket decorated with green leaves: purple figs, bunches of grapes, red pomegranates, dates and olives, sitting in their orchard.

A joyful procession of Hebrew farmers and boys walking up a road toward a golden city on a hill, each carrying a basket of fruit on his shoulder, in front an ox with gilded horns and a wreath of olive leaves on its head, a man playing a flute. Only men and boys in the picture.

In a bright stone courtyard, a Hebrew farmer with a beard handing a woven basket full of figs, grapes and pomegranates to a priest in a white robe and white turban who receives it with both hands, a stone altar in the background.

A Hebrew farmer with a beard and his sons standing in a bright stone courtyard with arms raised high in joyful thanks and faces lifted toward the bright sky, a basket of fruit resting on the ground beside a stone altar, other men rejoicing and singing around. Only men and boys in the picture.

Sad Hebrew men and boys sitting on the bank of a wide river in a faraway foreign land, strange tall brick towers of a foreign city behind them, their small harps hanging on willow trees, looking with longing toward the far horizon. Only men and boys in the picture.

Hebrew men and boys standing close together in an open field in a foreign land, praying with deep feeling, eyes closed, hands on their hearts, faces lifted toward a bright sky with sun rays breaking through the clouds. Only men and boys in the picture.

View from above of four long lines of Hebrew men and boys coming from four different directions and meeting at one crossroads: one line with camels from the desert, one from snowy mountains, one coming off wooden sailing ships at the shore, one from a forest. Only men and boys in the picture.

Happy Hebrew men and boys with bundles on their backs arriving at the top of a hill and seeing a beautiful green land with a golden city in front of them, one man kneeling and kissing the ground, others raising their arms with joy. Only men and boys in the picture.

Rich orchards and fields in a sunny green land: trees heavy with red pomegranates, figs and olives, vines full of purple grapes, golden wheat, Hebrew men and boys picking fruit into overflowing baskets, sheep grazing. Only men and boys in the picture.

Hebrew men and boys dancing joyfully in a big circle with hands on each other's shoulders in the square of a golden stone city, one bearded man in the middle hugging a scroll wrapped in a blue velvet cover, bright sunny sky. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe walking with a wooden staff from tent to tent through the desert camp, speaking kindly to groups of men and boys who gather around him and listen with love and respect. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing face to face with Joshua, a strong younger man with a short black beard and a red-brown robe, holding both of Joshua's shoulders firmly and encouraging him, a large crowd of men and boys watching. Only men and boys in the picture.

he_ctx.caption: חזק ואמץ: משה מחזק את יהושע

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe sitting alone inside a tent at a low wooden table, writing with a feather quill on a long parchment scroll that is seen only from the back side so no writing is visible, a small ink pot and an oil lamp beside him.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe handing a large rolled scroll with two wooden handles to three priests in white robes and white turbans who stretch out both hands to receive it with great respect, elders with grey beards standing around.

Inside a holy tent with embroidered curtains, two priests in white robes and white turbans carefully placing a large rolled scroll on a small shelf at the side of a golden chest that is completely covered with a blue cloth and has two long golden carrying poles. Soft golden light.

A king with a golden crown and a brown beard standing on a high wooden platform in a huge stone courtyard, holding an open scroll seen from behind and reading aloud, an enormous crowd of men, boys and babies held in their fathers' arms listening, green booths covered with palm branches at the sides. Only men and boys in the picture.
A big brown eagle landing on a high rocky cliff ledge with a long branch in its beak, adding it to a half-built nest made of sticks and twigs, blue sky and mountains behind. No people.

A finished round nest of sticks on a high rocky cliff ledge with three large white eggs lying in it, a big brown eagle standing beside the nest and looking at the eggs, blue sky and mountains behind. No people.

Close view of a nest of sticks on a high cliff: three tiny fluffy white eagle chicks just hatched, broken white eggshell pieces around them, one chick still half inside its cracked shell, a big brown eagle watching them gently. No people.

A big brown eagle standing on the edge of its nest on a high cliff, bending down and feeding three fluffy grey eagle chicks that stretch up with wide open beaks, a small fish held in the eagle's beak. No people.

A big brown eagle standing over its nest on a high cliff with both huge wings spread wide open like a roof above three young eagle chicks, sheltering them from rain and wind, dark rain clouds in the sky. No people.
A big brown eagle flying high in a bright blue sky above mountains and clouds with its huge wings spread, three young eagle chicks riding safely on its back between the wings, sunshine. No people.

he_ctx.caption: נושא אותם על כנפיו: כך ה' שומר עלינו

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing on a rock with both hands raised and spread out in blessing over twelve groups of men and boys standing in front of him, each group under its own tribal banner of a different plain color with no symbols. Only men and boys in the picture.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe seen from behind, climbing alone with a wooden staff up a steep rocky mountain path, far below him the desert camp of tents and tiny people looking up, late afternoon light.

Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing on the top of a high mountain, seen from behind, looking out over a wide beautiful green land below: a blue river, a city of palm trees, green hills, a sea far away, bright clear sky.

Sunset behind a high mountain, in the valley below a desert camp of tents where Hebrew men and boys sit on the ground sad and crying, wiping tears, some with heads bowed, all facing the mountain. Only men and boys in the picture.

Joshua, a strong man with a short black beard and a red-brown robe, standing confidently at the head of a great crowd of Hebrew men and boys, pointing forward toward a river and green land beyond it, the people following him willingly. Only men and boys in the picture.

A joyful celebration: Hebrew men and boys dancing in a circle, several bearded men holding scrolls dressed in velvet covers of red, blue and green with silver crowns on top, boys waving small plain colored flags, warm lamp light. Only men and boys in the picture.
